newsitem.title: POLAND: Kaczmarek may become Polish economy minister.
newsitem.headline: Kaczmarek may become Polish economy minister.

text.p: Poland's former privatisation minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said on Thursday he was considering accepting the post of economy minister once the portfolio is created in January.
"I have moved closer to agreeing to that," PAP news agency quoted Kaczmarek as saying.
The economy ministry will replace the current industry and foreign trade portfolios as of January 1, 1997, under a sweeping reorganisation of government ministries launched earlier this year.

Kaczmarek, considered one of the most pro-reform politicians in the ruling left-wing coalition, lost his job as the head of the privatisation ministry in October when it was transformed into the treasury portfolio. He is now a deputy minister.
